metadata.case_name: HO WAN YUNG v. A.S. WATSON & CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: Trainee in the Meat Department (Park'N Shop Superstore, Sceneway Plaza)

injuries.description: neck and right shoulder muscle strain or sprain
source: I am prepared to accept that the plaintiff sustained a neck and right shoulder muscle strain or sprain as a result of the injury sustained on 18 April 2005 and I so find.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

manifestations.description: recurrent right shoulder pain from the radiating down to the proximal forearm
paraesthesia, electrical-shock like symptoms and tightness at her right shoulder radiating down to the proximal forearm which disturbs her sleep
pulling tightness of the right side back on the flank from the scapular region down to the axilla
inability to make a tight fist
inability to hold on tight to an object such as a book or a pair of chopsticks
inability to carry a heavy load with her right hand
depressed mood, poor appetite, insomnia, hallucination and suicidal attempts
reduced sensation to light touch and pinprick sensation over the right side of her body (A&E examination 20 April 2005)
tenderness of the muscle area over her right neck, right arm, right forearm and soft tissues of the extensible surface of the right-hand
tenderness of the right shoulder on both anterior and supine aspects
decreased range of movement of the right shoulder
right C6 radiculopathy with positive Spurling sign and carpal tunnel syndrome signs (recorded at Orthopaedic Clinic)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency attendance at Prince of Wales Hospital (20 April 2005 and 29 April 2005)
Admission to medical ward (20 April 2005 to 23 April 2005)
Orthopaedic outpatient treatment at Prince of Wales Hospital
Physiotherapy (41 sessions from 7 June 2005 to 6 February 2006)
Physiotherapy for right thoracic outlet syndrome (11 sessions from 14 July to 28 September 2006)
Referral to Department of Psychiatry (November 2006) and psychiatric outpatient follow-up (from July 2007)
Counselling (23 sessions at Clinical Psychology Unit of the Social Welfare Department between 10 July 2007 and July 2009)
Psychiatric inpatient treatment at Shatin Hospital (6 February 2009 to 9 March 2009) with physiotherapy and occupational therapy during hospitalisation
Referral to Multi-Disciplinary Pain Department and Clinical Psychology (Pain) Department of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital (May 2009)
Psychiatric inpatient treatment at Shatin Hospital (31 July 2009 to 18 August 2009) with inpatient physiotherapy and occupational therapy

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: For the first 12 months after the accident, she could not do most of the housework and had to seek assistance from her husband

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: She suffered extreme pain in her right shoulder and right arm and did not want to have intimate relations with her husband and would decline his requests for sex

The pain and its effects led to more arguments and conflict between the couple; one night the husband tried to assault her; she filed for divorce in November 2006 and a decree absolute was pronounced in March 2007
